title: NED-B
description: NED-B was a Loader Droid in service of the Hidden Path. He worked with Tala Durith and also participated in the effort to see Obi-Wan Kenobi and Princess Leia Organa avoid the Inquisitors. When the Galactic Empire attacked the base at Jabiim, NED-B joined the fight against the encroaching Stormtroopers. Unfortunately, the Droid was destroyed in the battle.
